productName: LinkLater — Local Read-Later Vault & One-Click Obsidian Bridge

shortVideo.fullText: Tired of saving articles with context notes for reading later getting locked behind monthly subscriptions and external cloud portals? With LinkLater, Save Links With Immediate Notes & Tags runs right where you already work. One-Click Send to Obsidian Vault Bridge and Instant Offline Search & Unread Filtering—100% under your own custody. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.

demoVideo.fullText: Need a better way to handle saving articles with context notes for reading later, without handing your data to another monthly cloud landlord? Watch LinkLater in action: Capture why you saved an article while the thought is fresh—attach quotes, tags, and priority flags right in the side panel without leaving your tab. Push single saved articles or a compiled weekly reading digest directly into your local Obsidian vault with clean frontmatter and links. Plus, filter your reading queue by tag, domain, or read/unread status in 0ms—even when you are on a plane with no internet connection. Your reading list belongs to you. Export single items or your entire archive to standard Markdown or JSON anytime with zero lock-in. Software that lives where you do. No accounts, no tracking, and zero cloud rent—at 864zeros.com.
